v1.19.1a (22 April 2024) |feed_title = 🪂 Mercenary Base! 🪂 |previous_update = [[v1.18.4]] |next_update = [[v1.19.2]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''v1.19.0''' is the seventy-third update to be released in Tower Defense Simulator, on the 19th of April 2024. This update was also given the name '''Mercenary Base Update''', as this update added the [[Mercenary Base]]. This update encompassed four versions, the main v1.19.0 update (released 19 April 2024) and three minor updates, v1.19.0a (released 19 April 2024), v1.19.1 (released 19 April 2024) and v1.19.1a (released 22 April 2024). ==Additions== ===Towers=== *[[Mercenary Base]] : Many units were added as part of the [[Mercenary Base]]'s addition *[[Rifleman]] *[[Grenadier]] *[[Field Medic]] *[[Riot Guard]] ===Miscellanous=== *Upgrade UI ''Tooltip'' Option *Selectable Unit Timer ==Changes & Bugfixes== *New level tower claim prompt that appears when a tower can be claimed. *Changed most of the robux icon that appears in the store and inventory to use the current robux icon instead of the old one. *[[Discount Buff]] now reduces ability usage cost. *Fixed game loading screen. *Fixed unit spawnrate being displayed incorrectly when first placed down. *Fixed [[Turret]] and [[Mortar]] listing their old robux cost in the inventory. :In '''v1.19.0a''': *Fixed [[Mercenary Base]] being unobtainable. :In '''v1.19.1''': *Fixed [[Mercenary Base]] being purchasable for {{Coins|10,000}} upon reaching {{Level|150}} instead of being free. **Everyone who bought it was refunded. *Fixed the [[Mercenary Base]] using [[Military Base]]'s upgrade description *Fixed the [[Commander]]'s ''Call to Arms'' ability having a cost of {{Money|300}}. :In '''v1.19.1a''': *Fixed [[Mercenary Base]] dynamic placement limit being possible to bypass. ==Official Update Trailer== [[File:Mercenary Base Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|750px|thumb|center]] ==Gallery== {{Gallery|Open = Yes| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} V1.19Thumb.png V.1.17.0_UPD_THMBNL.png {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} Mercenaries!.png MBUpdateIcon2.png }} ==Official Update Log== NOTE: Not everything here will be accurate, as this is transcribed from the in-game update log. Several things may be incorrect, and there may be things that are missing. ===v1.19.0=== {{UpdateLog| {{UpdateBanner|MercenaryBaseThumbnailClean.png|🪂 Mercenary Base! 🪂}} {{UpdateH1|📜Update Log:}} {{UpdateH3|🎖️Unlock The New Level 150 Tower!}} *Available for free at level 150, or buy the gamepass to unlock early! *Pick and choose what mercenaries you want to spawn in the base's radius! *Use the 'Airdrop' ability to span in mercenaries on demand! *Has dynamic placement limit limits. (Solo {{=}}3, Duo {{=}} 2, Trio & Quad {{=}} 1) {{UpdateH3|🪖[[Rifleman]] Unit}} *Shoot enemies in a burst round from afar! *Has 3 upgrades {{UpdateH3|💥[[Grenadier|Grenedier]]{{sic}} Unit}} *Fire a grenade launcher at enemies to deal area damage! *Has 2 upgrades {{UpdateH3|🩹[[Field Medic|Medic]] Unit}} *Heal humanoid ally units, and provide 1 shot protection! *Has 2 upgrades {{UpdateH3|🛡️[[Riot Guard]] Unit!}} *Rush to the frontlines, and soak up damage! *If the [[Riot Guard]] builds enough speed, she will stun and deal extra impact damage! *Has 2 upgrades {{UpdateH1|🔨Other Changes:}} {{UpdateH3|🖥️User Interface Changes}} *Added new 'Tooltip' option to the upgrade UI list. *Added new spawner timer for selectable units. *You will be prompted to claim a level-locked tower, reaching the unlock level. *Changed 'Robux' icon in the shop and inventory. *Fixed game loading screen. }} {{DISPLAYTITLE:v1.19.0}} {{UpdateNavBox}} [[Category:Modern Updates]]
